s: Kamma debarim haasurim beyom tob ubo seip echad: keshem shebbeshabbat en olin al gabbe ilan, velo rokebin al gabbe behema, velo shatin al pene hammayim, velo mesappeqin, velo metappechin, velo meraqqedin, velo danin, velo meqaddeshin, velo konesin lechuppa, velo meyabbemim, velo megorshim, velo choletzim, velo maqdishim shum dabar legaboah, velo maprishin challa velo teruma umaasrot, velo podin et habben, veen qonin qinyan apillu bachazaqa o beqinyan sudar, veen notenin mattana sheen bah tzorek shabbat — kak en osin echad mikkol ellu beyom tob, ayyen simman shl"t vesh"v.
